trigger_visualization_draw: trigger the visualization hook to enable drawing on detection results using a config object
trigger_visualization_show: trigger the visualization hook to display detection results with a configurable wait time
trigger_visualization_save_dir: trigger the visualization hook to save detection results to a specified output directory
review_trigger_visualization_hook: review the trigger_visualization_hook function to understand how it enables MMDetection visualization
refactor_trigger_visualization_hook: refactor the trigger_visualization_hook to support additional visualization options beyond show and save
